title: FlowDatastream
description: Declarative datastream flow document (Story 8.7, Epic 8 Part D). The common interface through which both the admin UI and the LLM agent read/edit datastream flows. GUARDRAIL: additionalProperties:false everywhere so no authorization secret (token/access_token/secret) can be smuggled in; connection_ref_id is an opaque reference only.

id.description: ds_<ULID>. Absent on create; present on update.

intent.description: Schema-version-2 immutable intent; validated by datastream-intent.schema.json.

module_name.description: Connector manifest name (kebab-case). AD-2: data, never hardcoded.

connection_ref_id.description: OPAQUE reference to app.connection_ref. Never a secret. Validated to exist and belong to the project at upsert time.

config.description: Connector-specific config (R3 date normalization + R4 generic source). No auth material may appear here.

date_format.description: R3: strptime pattern for the source date column. Default: '%Y-%m-%d' (ISO 8601). Example: '%d/%m/%Y' for French dates.

source_timezone.description: R3: IANA timezone name for the source date column. Default: 'UTC'. Example: 'Europe/Paris'.

source.description: R4 generic module: data source type. 'csv_inline' = rows embedded in config; 'url' = fetched via HTTP.

url.description: R4 generic module: URL to fetch tabular data from (CSV or JSON). Required when source='url'.

rows.description: R4 generic module: inline tabular rows when source='csv_inline'. Each element is a dict with a date column and N measure/dimension columns.

date_column.description: R4 generic module: explicit name of the date column. Auto-detected when absent (looks for 'date', 'jour', 'day', etc.).

mappings.description: R4 generic module: source column -> canonical metric name mappings. Passed directly to the generic connector.

target_field.description: Target field name in app.target_fields, or null when unmapped.
